method_note: This is a pure EDA chapter over the raw AzureLMMInferenceDataset2025 trace. No simulation/mocker/GPU-inference claims exist here, so the 'ran on real silicon' failure mode does not apply. Every number was checked against the stats JSON that the figure/number is generated from; every methodological statement (class definitions, Hurst band, eval-window construction, forecast-context boundary) was checked against the generating .py. The prior pass marked nearly everything 'UNVERIFIABLE in provenance' because it looked only in the experiment tables; the correct internal source is eda_metric / the stats JSONs, against which almost all claims CONFIRM.
